resources.string: Zeus
Your list, and the list for the store you are at
Your teams: the live score, the latest big moment, or the next match
Olympus today: next events, top tasks, the top Home cards, a birthday if any. Resize up to a full page
Chronos: today and the next two days, the kind of day, and birthdays
Praxis: your open tasks, and the agents’ when paired. Tick your own to finish them
Ask Athena by typing or by voice
Ask Zeus: open apps, set alarms, call and text, by typing or by voice
Venus: today’s outfit from your closet
Now playing, with back, play or pause, and next
Lemnos: the server up or down, CPU, memory and disk
Cerberus: unseen alerts by severity
Pantheon: how Iris, Atlas and Echo are doing
Metron: Iris\'s and Atlas\'s plan windows and Athena\'s monthly cap
Argo: the next trip\'s countdown; on a travel day the next leg and when to leave
Odyssey: your last drive, this week\'s miles against the lease, and when to leave for work
Moneta: this week against a usual week, charges to check, and the next renewal. No amounts
Hestia: up to four of your lights and plugs. Tap one to switch it
Iaso: steps today, your weight trend and last night\'s sleep. Only on the widget you place
Eos: the morning brief\'s top lines
Agora: the latest message in the agents\' room, with a dot when it is new
Athena
